$comment: Courses that must never be served, whatever release is active.
This file is the durable record. The active release manifest carries its own copy in
emergencySuppressionList, and that copy is what the application actually applies, but
the manifest is regenerated by every publication and scripts/publish-catalogue.mjs
writes the list back as empty. Without a record kept outside the generated directory,
publishing a new catalogue would quietly resurrect every withdrawn course.
infra/scripts/preflight.mjs refuses to deploy unless the manifest's list contains
every id below. Add an id here first, then reapply it to the manifest.
Owner: course development. Each entry needs a reason and a date.
